GenesisClient.proxy() - Taskade's server-side proxy that routes API calls through the Genesis infrastructure, resolving secrets from Space Settings → Secrets so keys never reach the browser
Secret aliasing pattern: 'Bearer {{secret}}' placeholder in headers that Genesis replaces server-side with the actual key
The proxyFetch() wrapper function that standardizes the proxy call pattern across all providers
All 6 provider libraries use the same pattern now: strip API_KEYS import, use proxyFetch(secretAlias, url, method, headers, body) instead of fetch(url, { method, headers, body })
The Anthropic API uses x-api-key header instead of Authorization: Bearer, so its placeholder is 'x-api-key': '{{secret}}'
The Google API passes the key in the URL query param (?key={{secret}}) which is handled differently - the URL itself contains the placeholder
